:::{#def-constructive-proof}
#### Constructive proof

A **constructive proof**
[@wikipedia_constructive_proof]
of a [proposition](#def-proposition) $\exists x \in S,\ P(x)$
with an [existential quantifier](#def-existential-quantifier)
names a particular element of $S$
and shows that $P$ is true of it.
A proposition that opens with several existential quantifiers,
such as "there are [integers](#def-integers) $m$ and $n$ with $m + n = 1$",
gets a constructive proof that names one element for each [quantifier](#def-quantifier).

:::
